decision.reason: The only evidence is one changelog line [ev-1beb163c050d]. It says kubectl was upgraded to 1.32.1 and points to PR #21724. It doesn't say whether this is the vendored Go library, a binary bundled in an image, or both. Without that, the subject, change, applicability and consequence can't be written as typed values, so the PR or its diff, or the upgrade notes, are needed.
